name: agent-containers-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-containers on a fresh box and assert its solo DEGRADE-SAFE contract. agent-containers can consult agent-worktrees only through an optional knowledge-overlay config lookup, and that shell-out must fail open when the base is absent; installed alone it must still provision, expose a binstub with a real version, and answer read/idempotent no-venue verbs (leases/relay-profile/namespace-target-repo) rather than hard-fail on a missing agent-worktrees base. Name-free / public.

stages.title: binstub on PATH + reports a REAL version
DEGRADE-SAFE: read verbs fall open without an agent-worktrees base
